title: backlog.py goal prints the answered gates of an item's ancestors
goal: backlog.py goal ID prints the answered gates of the item's parent chain beside its own goal, so a worker brief built from it cannot contradict an answer; SP-fvztfmtm's TK-ymbmdww4 was briefed for per-row keys against the answered shared-counts gate of ST-mn4j4fis and only the worker's reading of the story caught it
